title: GlueXML signature result counts as OK
adr: docs/adr/0009-client-patch-overlay.md (accepted 2026-10-04; appendix A pins these bytes)

edits.before_asm: cmp eax, 3 (83 f8 03); ja 0x004da81e; jmp [4*eax+0x004da9b4]  -- switch on XML_VerifyTocSignature's result (0 missing / 1 corrupt / 2 modified quit; 3 OK -> 0x004da835)
edits.after_asm: jmp short 0x004da835 (eb 4e)  -- always take the result-3 (OK) path; the next 3 bytes become unreachable
edits.why: makes a missing/corrupt/modified GlueXML signature behave as result 3, the same target the jump table already uses for OK (table @0x004da9b4 entry 3 = 0x004da835)

edits.before_asm: jne 0x004da81e  -- after XML_LoadToc, the 16-byte memcmp of the live MD5 of the loaded tree against the signed MD5 from the .sig; nonzero -> App_Quit(9)
edits.after_asm: 6 x nop  -- fall through to the normal post-load path (0x004da8f1, glue Lua registration)
edits.why: without it the second, silent MD5 comparison quits right after a modified tree loads (login-screen spike, Q1 pseudocode)

untouched: FrameXML (FUN_0052a980), AddOn signature handling (FUN_005f79a0), XML_VerifyTocSignature itself and every other byte of Wow.exe
